title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks (Kipf & Welling, 2017)
focus: Explain one step of graph-convolutional propagation (Section 2, Eq. 2) on a small undirected graph. The learner edits which of 4–5 nodes are connected, a scalar feature on each node, and switches the self-loops (Ã = A + I) on and off. Show the graph, the normalized matrix D̃^−1/2 Ã D̃^−1/2 as a heatmap, and every node's feature before and after one propagation step (no weights, no nonlinearity). Check that the normalized matrix is symmetric, and that without self-loops a node's own feature does not contribute to its new value.
